message: No detected input validation: The code directly reads config values and file paths without any schema checks, type assertions, or value-range guards; exceptions are silently swallowed with bare except clauses.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code only reads local file-system paths and directories; there is no remote data fetching, and consequently no checksum verification, authentication, or pinned revision handling.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses LabelEncoder to transform labels but performs no validation of label distributions, comparison against expected label sets, or any label-noise/flipping detection before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code saves models via save_model() and loads/uses classifiers directly from sklearn/keras constructors with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading serialized models.

No detected label distribution validation: The code applies LabelEncoder and fits classifiers but never checks class balance, expected label sets, or detects anomalous label distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/test directories are used, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no formal isolation guarantee, and no cross-validation or independent replication of metrics to guard against tampering.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to classifiers; the code reads files and features directly without any sanitization checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and decision scores are passed directly to metric functions with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation on the outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses traditional ML classifiers (SVC, RF, MLP, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
